name: mobile-library-light
prompt:
Create ONE narrow portrait mobile UI image for the same Wave Player as reference. THIS IS A NEW MOBILE COMPOSITION, not the desktop layout squeezed narrower. Intended viewport390x844, request image780x1688 or an equivalent tall narrow 0.462 width/height ratio. Player occupies full viewport width with8px safe gutters, no device frame or broad board margins. Use vertical space with pinned identity/top and pinned waveform/transport bottom; collection occupies middle. Entire composition and all controls visible.

Latest USER REQUIREMENTS: NO TABS, no VISUAL/LIBRARY tab selector. NO "A/B" text button, no theme switch. Phosphor regular utility icons. Tight card composition; retain Inter + TX-02 + selective Departure Mono.

Top: "Low Tide" prominent TX-02-like monospace24px, then Inter12px "North Window | Tidal Studies". No big library button beside title. Directly below a small row with Phosphor ArrowLeft (returns to signal view), compact "Library" heading in Departure Mono-like pixel face11px, "5 files", and a small Phosphor Plus icon to add files. NO duplicate X close, no underlined tabs. This internal library replaces the signal field completely: DO NOT SHOW AN OSCILLOSCOPE OR ART STRIP ON THIS SCREEN.
Library content, exactly five synthetic local files, rows separated by fine rules and tight 8px padding. Inter for track/artist text, TX-02 for durations and filename, Departure Mono pixel type for tiny short state labels. No artwork thumbnails, no pill badges. Header "SESSION" with understated "5 files", tiny "+ Add files" text action. Rows:
"Low Tide" / "North Window · Tidal Studies" / "04:32": small speaker symbol and unboxed "PLAYING" label, the loaded track.
"Glass Current" / "Static Bloom · Afterimage" / "06:18": separately selected using neutral tinted fill and a fine dotted focus outline, small unboxed "SELECTED" marker and "Load" text action. Browsing never replaces Low Tide automatically.
"A Map of the Room After Everyone Has Left" / "North Window · Tidal Studies — Late Sessions" / "08:47": allow natural two-line wrapping, keep duration aligned.
"field-recording_2026-08-19_take-07.wav" / "Metadata unavailable" / "—": honest filename fallback, wrap without omitting any portion.
"Night Transit" / "Static Bloom · Afterimage" / "—": warning icon, "Could not load" and small "Retry" action.
Compact footer "This session only". No search, filter chips, upload, database, playlists, or oversized add/close buttons.
Use those five rows, compact Inter13px names, metadata12px, TX-02 times12px. Narrow layout wraps long title and filename; do not omit words. Use unboxed PLAYING and SELECTED in Departure Mono-like pixel type11px and neutral focus outline; durations right-aligned. Phosphor SpeakerHigh for playing row, WarningCircle for failed row. Load and Retry may remain tiny understandable text actions. No header "SESSION" needed because Library is already named; no duplicate add-files button because header Plus does that action.
Below collection and "This session only", persistent full-track waveform at acknowledged01:24 /04:32 and exact cursor30.9%. Loop off, no A/B region or text. Bottom has small Phosphor Queue and Repeat icons at LEFT, independent centered Phosphor SkipBack/Pause/SkipForward group, SpeakerHigh at RIGHT. Quiet small icons, no crowding and no giant button boxes, intended touch regions44px while glyphs16-18px. Volume slider is hidden. No System/Light/Dark or settings controls in card. App settings are elsewhere.
Light neutrals #f4f4f0 ground,#fffffc surface,#171714 ink,#d6d6ce rules. No neon blue state pills. Thin rules,8px row insets. Exact caption OUTSIDE UI in a small bottom strip, may wrap into two lines: "Design fixture — simulated waveform and playback". Output a single individual image, not a contact sheet.
